data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $177,838,000 (2018: $215,601,000) is a deterioration of $9,070,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2018: deterioration $48,466,000).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Significant losses on the Property D&F and Property Binders classes which materially contributed to the 2017 year of account loss and resulted in remediation actions in subsequent years.
Additional losses in 2017 that affected the Property classes and contributed to the 2017 year loss.
Affected the 2018 year of account, most notably Property D&F, Property Binders and Property Treaty classes, contributing to loss activity on those years.
A number of individual large losses and increased frequency in the US Open market sub-class produced adverse development on prior accident years in the Non-Marine Liability class.

named_events.event_name: Hurricane Dorian; Typhoon Faxai; Typhoon Hagibis
named_events.loss_description: Total net cost to Syndicate 1969 of Hurricane Dorian and Typhoons Faxai and Hagibis for the 2019 calendar year was $5.2m; $3.0m was from Property D&F and Property Binders for Hurricane Dorian and $2.2m was from the 10% net retained share of the Property Treaty class for the three events.
Significant losses from natural catastrophe events in 2017 which heavily impacted the 2017 account.
Two earthquakes in Mexico in 2017 that contributed to the 2017 year losses.
Substantial catastrophe events in 2018 that impacted the 2018 year of account, particularly Property classes.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2019 gross claims outstanding were $568.26m. During 2019 prior-year reserve estimates moved adversely on a gross basis, producing an estimated strengthening of reserves of approximately $39.9m (about 7.0% of opening gross claims outstanding) when measured from the syndicate's gross claims development triangle. The managing agent notes a $9.07m deterioration when discussed within net calendar year claims (net of reinsurance). The movements reflect adverse development principally driven by large loss and catastrophe activity in 2016-2017 (notably Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria and Mexican earthquakes) and adverse development in the Non-Marine Liability portfolio (increased frequency / large individual losses), together with IBNR recalibration on newer classes.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $177,838,000 (2018: $215,601,000) is a deterioration of $9,070,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2018: deterioration $48,466,000).
The syndicate's results for the current year have been affected by prior year deterioration on Non-Marine Liability, predominantly on specific large claims.
We have seen an increase in the frequency of claims and a higher percentage of insureds making claims.
In 2017 ... Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and the two earthquakes in Mexico.
The Property D&F class was further impacted by under-performing risks in the habitational class that had higher than expected levels of attritional claims.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, gross) prior-year comparative column (2018) and expressed in millions USD. Prior-year development on a GROSS basis was calculated from the published gross claims development triangle (sum of diagonal changes for UW years <=2017) - triangle-derived gross strengthening = +$39.9m. The report also explicitly states a $9.07m deterioration 'included within net calendar year claims incurred' (this is net of reinsurance). No explicit single-line 'movement in prior year's provision' gross figure was provided, so the gross triangle was used as primary source for gross PYD. All monetary amounts are in the report's native currency (USD) and converted from $'000 to millions. Confidence ratings: 1.0 = balance sheet exact; 0.8 = calculated from table values; narrative net figure flagged as net-of-reinsurance.
